journey.name: Wear - Launcher Widget Deep Links
journey.description:
Verifies the launcher widget (shown as a tile on watches without widgets): it shows the unread message count and its three targets open Messages, Home and New post. Each target starts a fresh back stack over the landing screen, so going back lands on the landing screen and then leaves the app, wherever the app was before.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped and the Nubecita widget added to the watch; docs/wear-testing.md has the commands that add and show it. A bench scenario stays for the life of the process, so the widget keeps showing it after the app is closed with back.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default", then go back until the app closes
Show the Nubecita widget
Verify that the widget shows three targets: Messages with "2 new", Home and New post
Tap Home on the widget
Verify that Nubecita opens on the feed "Following"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the widget is shown again
Tap Messages on the widget
Verify that Nubecita opens on the conversation list titled "Messages"
Tap the conversation with Ana Ruiz
Verify that the thread with Ana Ruiz is shown
Show the Nubecita widget
Tap Home on the widget
Verify that Nubecita shows the feed "Following", not the thread with Ana Ruiz
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown, not the thread or the conversation list
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that Nubecita is no longer on screen
Show the Nubecita widget
Tap New post on the widget
Verify that the system text input screen is shown with the label "New post"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "no_conversations", then go back until the app closes
Show the Nubecita widget
Verify that the widget shows "No new messages" and no count
Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "signed_out", then go back until the app closes
Show the Nubecita widget
Verify that the widget reads "Sign in on your phone" and does not offer Messages, Home or New post
Tap the widget
Verify that Nubecita opens on "Sign in on your phone" with an "Open on phone" button, and not on a feed
